description: This file defines a Timer class for managing millisecond timers based on pthreads, including exception handling, message queue management, and callback mechanisms. It also defines a TimerException class for error handling related to timers.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class implementing a millisecond timer using pthreads, with message queue management and callback support.

classes.name: TimerException
classes.description: An exception class for handling errors related to Timer operations.

methods.name: Timer
methods.description: Constructor for Timer class, initializes callback, user data, and timer name.

methods.name: ~Timer
methods.description: Destructor for Timer class, cleans up resources.

methods.name: arm
methods.description: Arms the timer for a specified timeout in milliseconds.
